summary: American Tower Corporation filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) covering a benchmark offering of senior unsecured notes in three tranches: 2031, 2033 and 2036 maturities, with interest payable semi-annually each March 15 and September 15 beginning March 15, 2027. Pricing, principal amounts, coupons and proceeds are left blank pending completion. The notes rank equally with existing senior unsecured debt and are structurally subordinated to subsidiary obligations, with make-whole optional redemption and no exchange listing. J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley and Scotiabank are joint book-running managers. This is ordinary investment-grade refinancing, not a special situation; watch final coupons, size and spread to Treasuries.
